parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of steel, forming the main structural body that supports all other components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, houses insulation, and supports the door and internal compartments.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the refrigerator is made of steel and includes insulation and a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the refrigerator compartment to maintain internal temperature and allows user access to the interior.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Decoration (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This decorative part, likely a logo or trim, is made of plastic and attached to the refrigerator door or frame.
parts.Functional_description: It serves an aesthetic purpose, displaying branding or enhancing the visual appeal of the refrigerator.
parts.Movement_description: This part is fixed and does not move during operation.
